summary.executiveSummaryReference: The group planned the Sylmar surveillance audit, including timing, hotel and site logistics, training, document access and Niamh’s specialist software role. Stuart described the device context, expected standards and risk areas, and confirmed the audit would be a full routine surveillance audit with findings. Niamh’s work is expected to focus on software management, validation, purchasing controls, SBOMs, version rollout and related software risks, with final logistics depending on Stuart’s risk analysis and document access arrangements.
